answer: Because the timing is recorded against the umber challenge, the oasis audit can replay the quartz history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 177 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 509 identities would post 1688 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
